integrity: The proof, empirical verification, and prior-source comparisons are self-contained in the package; no independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes every petal is a cycle meeting all others only at the same vertex. Finite checks do not establish the infinite-parameter claim. Unindexed results and general graph-gluing formulae remain possible publication-priority risks.
title: Exact orientation and minimum-set spectra of total domination on cycle bouquets
